color_logic.reason: PERSON is the first evidence-bearing authority.

art_direction.typography_logic: Large meaning-unit headlines, compact labels, readable Japanese body text.
art_direction.composition_logic: A soft arrival opening, tactile care surface and generous booking pause; the page slows before asking for action.
art_direction.photography_logic: Role-driven photography is the primary visual authority; vector scenes are support only.

art_direction.icon_logic: No generic icon wall; use line markers tied to the process sequence.
art_direction.texture_logic: Subtle ruled-paper and calibration marks, never a decorative grain overlay.
art_direction.motion_logic: settle_into_care; one restrained reveal per section; no infinite or blocking animation.
art_direction.craft_catch: A breath mark carries the customer from a vague need for care to a chosen kind of time.

art_direction_dimensions.crop_logic: no client image dependency; abstract geometry carries the role
